long:
Empire Earth II: Gold Edition refines the series’ time-spanning gameplay with a host of new features. With advanced AI, picture-in-picture control, dynamic weather and many other additions, this RTS doesn’t just stand the test of time – it annihilates it.
Transcend the Ages

Create, build and your empire as you progress through 15 epochs and more than 10,000 years of history. Lead the great nations of Korea, Germany and America in the main campaign and Egypt, Russia and the Masai in The Art of Supremacy expansion (included in Empire Earth 2: Gold Edition). Become the greatest conqueror of all time in this essential sequel to the award-winning Empire Earth.

Empire Earth II: Gold Edition includes

The original Empire Earth II

The Art of Supremacy expansion

(Multiplayer notice: Because the official multiplayer servers have been taken offline, playing over the Internet is no longer possible.)
Key Features
Master 18 unique civilizations featuring new units, powers and leaders.

Relive legendary moments from human history across 6 globe-spanning campaigns - from the time of the Pharaohs to the reign of Napoleon.

Command 500 unique units and buildings in your epic rise to power.

Maintain control of different regions in real-time with the new Picture-in-Picture system.

Explore other impressive additions to Empire Earth; Take advantage of the new time-saving Citizen Manager system, adapt to ever-changing weather conditions and take on dynamic AI opponents.

Create and customize your own maps and civilizations.
